verdict.rationale: The current Milvus Lite docs say the shared Milvus API covers "vector data persistence and management" and "vector CRUD operations", which implies entity deletion, but there is no dedicated documentation of deletion semantics or retention controls. An old community thread says deletion was not yet supported, but it describes a feature then planned for the next quarter, so it does not concretely contradict the current docs. Missing for 10: documented retention policies (e.g., TTL or auto-expiry), explicit delete/drop API documentation and guarantees such as purge or compaction behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
